props.heading: The lesson plan is the first safe place to start.
props.body: Claude drafts — it doesn't know your students, your timing constraints, or your school's context, so what it produces is always a starting point. You edit: cut what doesn't fit, adjust timing, add the examples that will actually land for this particular class. The draft takes two minutes. The editing is where your expertise shows.

props.heading: Differentiation used to mean three separate plans for three tiers of learner.
props.body: Now it means one prompt with three outputs: the same lesson adapted for students who are behind, students who are on track, and students who are ready to go deeper. You review all three, select the elements that fit, and merge them. One Sunday task, not three.
